verdict.rationale: Paddle documents four official server-side SDKs (Node.js, Python, Go, PHP). The Node SDK ships TypeScript definitions, iterator pagination and webhook-signature helpers, and the Python SDK offers auto-pagination, operation classes and a webhook verifier. These are complemented by the client-side Paddle.js, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec for generating clients, and SDK references exposed to agents via the docs MCP. Missing for 10: detailed documentation for the Go and PHP SDKs (only named), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
